candidates.subject: Stripe
candidates.title: Stripe Alternatives 2026: Fees and Features Compared
candidates.readerQuestion: What should I use instead of Stripe for accepting card payments? [verb-only — no PAA, no completions]
candidates.workingAnswer: Square, Helcim, Authorize.net, Shopify Payments, Paddle and Clover are six Stripe alternatives, and most of them publish the same 2.9% + 30¢ online card rate that Stripe does. Stripe's 2.9% + 30¢ costs $1.75 on a $50 online sale, while Square's free plan at 3.3% + 30¢ costs $1.95, a $0.20 difference per sale.
candidates.counterexample: Helcim publishes an interchange-plus margin of 0.50% + 25¢ on keyed and online sales up to $50,000 a month, which is $0.50 on a $50 sale. Stripe's 2.9% + 30¢ is $1.75, so Helcim costs less whenever average interchange stays under $1.25 per $50 sale (2.5% of the ticket). Helcim's page does not publish interchange as a number, so the flip point is arithmetic only: above 2.5% Stripe costs less, below it Helcim does. On the $60,000 and $200,000 monthly tiers the margins fall to $0.425 and $0.375 per $50 sale, which moves the flip point to 2.65% and 2.75%.

candidates.whatWouldChange: A change to Stripe's 2.9% + 30¢ standard rate, a published Helcim interchange average, or a Paddle or Stripe Managed Payments fee change would move the cost ranking.
candidates.decisionGap: Pricing pages list rates in isolation and do not show per-sale cost at a fixed ticket size, the $25 to $49 monthly fees that offset identical percentage rates, or the point where interchange-plus beats a flat rate.

candidates.subject: Square
candidates.title: Square Alternatives 2026: Fees and Plans Compared
candidates.readerQuestion: What should I use instead of Square for taking card payments in person? [verb-only — no PAA, no completions]
candidates.workingAnswer: Stripe Terminal, Clover, Toast, SumUp, Shopify POS and Helcim are six Square alternatives, and Stripe Terminal's 2.7% + 5¢ in-person rate is the lowest per-sale cost among the flat-rate options on a $30 ticket. Square's free plan publishes 2.6% + 15¢ in person, which costs $0.93 on a $30 sale against $0.86 at Stripe Terminal, a $0.07 gap before hardware.
candidates.counterexample: Stripe Terminal's 2.7% + 5¢ and Square Free's 2.6% + 15¢ cost the same at a $100 average ticket (0.027 x 100 + 0.05 = 2.75; 0.026 x 100 + 0.15 = 2.75). Above $100 per sale Square Free costs less per sale than Stripe Terminal. Square Premium's 2.4% + 15¢ matches Stripe Terminal at a $33.33 ticket, so on a $60 ticket Square Premium costs $1.59 per sale against $1.67, an $0.08 saving that takes 1,863 sales a month to cover Premium's $149 fee.

candidates.subject: Expensify
candidates.title: Expensify Alternatives 2026: Pricing and Plans Compared
candidates.readerQuestion: What should I use instead of Expensify for expense reports? [verb-only — no PAA, no completions]
candidates.workingAnswer: Zoho Expense, Ramp, Brex, BILL Spend & Expense, Sage Expense Management and Rydoo are six Expensify alternatives, and four of them publish a software price below Expensify's $5 per member per month. Zoho Expense Standard is $4 per user billed monthly, and Ramp, Brex Essentials and BILL Spend & Expense each list $0 per user.
candidates.counterexample: At 3 members Expensify Collect costs $15 a month while Zoho Expense's Free plan, capped at 3 users, costs $0. At 100 members Zoho Expense Standard at $4 a user is $400 a month against Expensify's $500, a $100 monthly gap ($1,200 a year). Below 5 users the ranking flips toward Expensify: at 4 members Expensify Collect is $20 a month, while Rydoo and Sage Expense Management both state a 5-user starting point, which is $60 and $59.95 at 5 users.
